player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Loaf''') posted a [[Dark]] list on DeckTech in June 2001.
description: Contrary to popular belief, building the DSII does NOT suck. Well, not as much as you might believe anyway.
cards: Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
posted: palpy x2 (update: forgot to list)
posted: All Power To Weapons x2
posted: We Shall Double Our Efforts
notes: The published title 'Gay A$$ Jank' uses 'gay' as a put-down plus a masked 'ass', so the page is titled Geoff Gallo-Cornell DS; the published title stays in the source citation.
Posted 4 June 2001, before Coruscant; no Coruscant-set card in the list, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting5': Endor, Operational As Planned (the starting interrupt; 'for' runs into the next line), Death Star II, Jerjerrod and Desperate Counter; these count toward the 60. There is no objective, so Endor is the starting location. Operational As Planned takes Death Star II, Jerjerrod and any Effect into hand, so no Effect is named as the starting Effect.

The author's update says he forgot to list five characters (Palpatine x2, Tarkin, Xizor, 4-LOM) and that the deck has 12 characters; they are added as Emperor Palpatine x2, Grand Moff Tarkin, Prince Xizor and 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (the strategy says 4-LOM removes Jedi immunity, which is the Concussion Rifle's 'target may not use its game text').
Posted 'All Three DSII Sectors' dested Death Star II: Capacitors, Coolant Shaft and Reactor Core (one each; the Locations section counts 10).
Posted 'Cheapo TIE Guns' (1 copy) dested SFS L-s7.2 TIE Cannon, which deploys on any TIE (free on a TIE/ln); the strategy and Desperate Counter refer to TIEs armed with weapons.

Posted 'Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); 'Mauls Saber' Maul's Lightsaber (Tatooine); 'Tatooine x2' the Dark Premiere Tatooine system (2 copies as posted); 'Lars Farm', 'Tat Dbay' and 'Mos Epsa' the Dark sites; 'Roll/Dark Manuevers' the combo Dark Maneuvers & Tallon Roll; 'dread' Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'empys shield/sword' The Emperor's Shield and The Emperor's Sword.
The 'Interrupts11' header is off by one (12 interrupts listed), as the author says in his update. The 'Epic Events1' header is not a card.
Total is 60 with the five characters from the update.
